verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an Admin API that 'provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources', which is effectively a UI-parity claim. API tokens are documented for 'other tools and automation', and an official MCP server lets LLM assistants create and manage flags. missing for 10: an explicit statement that every UI action has an API equivalent, detailed per-resource API coverage evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
